set.page.pluginsSub: What adds places of its own to the window, and where to get it
plug.catalogAllIn: Everything in the catalogue is installed.
plug.catalogEmpty: Nothing to install yet: no source answered, and the cache is empty.
plug.staleSub: A source did not answer; installed plugins work as they did
plug.sourcesNone: No source: there is nowhere to read a catalogue from.
plug.note.page: A plugin is installed switched off: it shows what it asks for first, and is turned on only with your consent.
plug.note.builtin: A built-in plugin is switched off, never removed.
plug.note.external: A plugin is a program of its own; the daemon checks its permissions on every call.
plug.perm.entries: Read ssh keys and items with keyward fields
plug.perm.itemsWrite: Create items and change their fields
plug.perm.clipboard: Put values on the clipboard, concealed and cleared on time
plug.perm.sshSign: Sign with the vault's ssh keys
plug.perm.secrets: Read passwords and other secret fields
plug.perm.keychain: Keep its own secrets in the keychain, behind Touch ID
plug.perm.noneSub: It needs neither the vault nor the network
plug.perm.added: New: the update asks for more than before
plug.perm.weighty: Weighty: with the network it could carry secrets away
plug.unverifiedSub: It came past the catalogue: no publisher's signature, nothing to compare
plug.consent.title: Turn on {name}
plug.consent.lede: The plugin “{name}” {version} is on disk and switched off. Turning it on is agreeing to what it asks for:
plug.consent.unverifiedSub: A plugin is a program that runs as you; install it only if you trust whoever you got it from

plug.consent.added.one: The update asks for {n} more permission
plug.consent.added.other: The update asks for {n} more permissions

plug.consent.addedSub: Until you agree, the plugin does not run
plug.consent.stays: The keys never leave the daemon
plug.consent.staysSub: The daemon checks the permissions on every call; turn it off at any time
plug.consent.note: Its places come onto the path at once
plug.off.title: Turn off {name}
plug.off.lede: Its places leave the path, and its calls stop.
plug.off.s1sub: It gets no events and answers no calls
plug.off.staysSub: Its settings and state stay on disk
plug.remove.title: Remove {name}
plug.remove.lede: The plugin “{name}”'s folder goes with its settings and state. There is nothing to bring them back from — only installing it again.
plug.remove.s2sub: The package, the settings and the state, for good
plug.install.title: Install {name} {version}
plug.install.lede: The package is downloaded and checked; the plugin is installed switched off.
plug.install.s1signed: And check the publisher's signature and the checksum
plug.install.s1unsigned: No signature: only the checksum is checked
plug.install.s2sub: It does nothing until you agree
plug.install.s3sub: Turn it on if you agree
plug.trust.title: Trust the publisher {name}
plug.trust.lede: The publisher “{name}”'s key becomes trusted, and the packages it signs — “{plugin}” too — can be installed. This decides for all of its plugins at once.
plug.trust.compare: Compare the five words with those the publisher shows
plug.trust.noFingerprint: The catalogue names no key fingerprint
plug.trust.s2: The key joins the trusted ones
plug.trust.s2sub: Its signature is checked on every package
plug.file.lede: A developer's path: a .zip or .tar.gz archive, or a package folder with plugin.json.
plug.address.lede: A link to a .tar.gz package. An address outside the catalogue has no signature to compare.
plug.address.label: Address
plug.address.bad: An address starts with https:// or file://
plug.source.lede: The address of a catalogue's index.json, where plugins are read from.
plug.source.stays: What is installed does not change
plug.source.removeLede: Its plugins leave the catalogue; installed ones stay.
plug.source.r1sub: The catalogue is read without it
plug.source.removeStaysSub: Plugins installed from it work as they did
plug.refresh.lede: The catalogue is read from its sources again, past the cache.
plug.refresh.stays: What is installed does not change
